#  11882 - Software Project Management Modulübersicht  
|  Module Number:   | **11882 - module is no longer offered from SS 2024**  |  
| --- | --- |  
| Module Title:  | **Software Project Management**  |  
|  Softwareprojektmanagement   |  
| Department:  |  Faculty 1 - Mathematics, Computer Science, Physics, Electrical Engineering and Information Technology   |  
| Responsible Staff Member:  | 
  * Prof. Dr. rer. nat. Lambers, Leen 

 |  
| Language of Teaching / Examination:  | English  |  
| Duration:  | 1 semester  |  
| Frequency of Offer:  |  Every summer semester   |  
| Credits:  |  
| Learning Outcome:  | Knowledge and practical skills in basic methods and tools for the organisation and management of software development projects. Development of a personal work discipline for conducting software projects.  |  
| Contents:  | Process models, maturity models for software processes, process design, process measurement and optimisation, effort and cost estimation, quality assurance, team mangament, human factors, communication, work organisation.  |  
| Recommended Prerequisites:  | Knowledge of basic programming techniques, experience in the implementation of small software development projects, e.g. knowledge of the topics of module 
  * 12202: Software Lab Project

 |  
| Mandatory Prerequisites:  | None  |  
| Forms of Teaching and Proportion:  | 
  * Lecture / 4 Hours per Week per Semester 
  * Exercise / 2 Hours per Week per Semester 
  * Self organised studies / 150 Hours 

 |  
| Teaching Materials and Literature:  | 
  * W. Humphrey: A Discipline of Software Engineering

 |  
| Module Examination:  | Prerequisite + Final Module Examination (MAP)  |  
| Assessment Mode for Module Examination:  |  **Prerequisite:**
  * Successful completion of exercise assignments 

**Final module examination:**
  * Oral examination, 30-45 min.

 |  
| Evaluation of Module Examination:  | Performance Verification – graded  |  
| Limited Number of Participants:  | None  |  
| Part of the Study Programme:  | 
  * no assignment

 |  
| Remarks:  | 
  * Study programme Computer Science M.Sc.: Compulsory elective module in complex „Practical Computer Science“ (level 400)
  * Study programme Information and Media Technology M.Sc.: Compulsory elective module in „Computer Based Systems“
  * Study programme Cyber Security M.Sc.: Compulsory elective module in complex „Computer Science“
  * Study programme Applied Mathematics M.Sc.: Compulsory elective module in complex „Applications“, field „Computer Science“

 |  
| Module Components:  | 
  * Lecture: Software Project Management
  * Accompanying exercises
  * Related examination

 |  
| Components to be offered in the Current Semester:  | 
  * no assignment

 |  
| Follow-up Module/s:  |  Phase-out module since: 03.01.2024 
  * without Follow-up Module/s

 |
